title: Run Lakeflow pipelines as a group
body: You can now set a pipeline's run-as identity to an account group, in addition to a user or a service principal. Pipeline updates run with the group's permissions, so a team can own an automated pipeline without tying it to one person's account. See [Set the run-as identity to a group](/aws/en/ldp/configure-pipeline#run-as-group).
